title: ContextFrame
description: Multi-turn state passed across voice/chat searches within a session. Maintained in browser sessionStorage (key: asc_context_frame). Sent with Track B /intent calls only — never with provisional searches. Max 10 turns; oldest dropped when exceeded.

session_id.description: Client-generated UUID v4, stable for the browser session. Must NOT be persisted to localStorage — context must not cross sessions.

turns.description: Ordered history of previous turns in this session, newest last.

accumulated_filters.description: Filters that persist across turns (e.g. 'five servings' stays in context for follow-up queries).
